summary: Iteration 30 tested: (1) new /api/site/maintenance snapshot shape (site_status/site_status_lang/maintenance_bg_mode/maintenance_bg_url/version), (2) PUT /api/settings persistence of new maintenance fields as admin, (3) portal documents CRUD (admin upload/list/delete + 401 for unauth portal read), (4) MaintenancePage improvements (lang toggle, admin lock, 3-services line, bokeh screensaver rotation every 8s, mode chip for maintenance & coming_soon), (5) UserDocumentsPanel inside UserQuickView modal (upload + list + delete), (6) Portal anonymous render, (7) regression: preview=1 renders normal site. All 5 pytest cases pass and all frontend flows pass. Site restored to live at end.
critical_code_review_comments: maintenance_bg_mode pattern is '^(dynamic|custom)$' in the SiteSettings schema but the review request description said 'static' — either the schema or the request description is out of sync. Not a bug (custom works), but worth aligning the docstring/naming so admin UI matches.
AdminDashboard.jsx is still >2700 lines and now hosts UserDocumentsPanel too — good candidate for extracting into /components/admin/UserDocumentsPanel.jsx.
Portal admin delete button relies on window.confirm — consider using a shadcn AlertDialog for consistent UX (also easier to test without page.on('dialog') hooks).
Bokeh screensaver uses setInterval(8s) without pause on visibilitychange — background tabs will still churn Unsplash requests (minor performance nit).
seed_data_creation: None persisted — test document was uploaded then deleted; portal document collection returned to prior state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public snapshot /api/site/maintenance now returns 5 keys (site_status/site_status_lang/maintenance_bg_mode/maintenance_bg_url/version). MaintenancePage exposes data-testids: maintenance-page (with data-mode), maintenance-services, maintenance-lang-toggle, maintenance-admin-lock (href=/admin/login), maintenance-logo, maintenance-mode-chip, maintenance-bokeh. Language pref stored in localStorage.pb_splash_lang. Portal documents endpoints under /api/portal/documents (session-gated) and /api/admin/portal/documents (admin, multipart upload with query params user_email/doc_type/label). UserQuickView modal in AdminDashboard now contains user-documents-panel with user-doc-type, user-doc-label, user-doc-file-input, user-doc-upload; each doc row is user-doc-row-{id} with user-doc-delete-{id}. Site left in status=live.
rca of the issue: N/A — all scoped features passed on first-pass; only test-side fix needed was using 'custom' instead of 'static' for maintenance_bg_mode to match the SiteSettings Pydantic pattern.
